newsitem.title: USA: U.S. soybean weekly export sales highlights - USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. soybean weekly export sales highlights - USDA.

text.p: USDA soybean export sales highlights in latest reporting week:
Net sales of 499,600 MT were 24 percent above the previous week and 8 percent above the 4-week average.

Major increases for Mexico (181,900 MT), Japan (97,500 MT), Germany (65,800 MT reflecting 4,900 in new sales, 61,000 in destination changes and 100,00 in cancellations), Italy (55,900 MT includes 5,900 in new sales), and Indonesia (31,500 MT) were partially offset by reductions for unknown destinations (38,900 MT).
Sales activity for the 1997/98 marketing year of 111,300 MT were for Indonesia (63,000 MT), unknown destinations (35,000 MT), and Japan (13,300 MT).

Exports of 815,600 MT were down 7 percent from the previous week, but up 11 percent from the 4-week average. The primary destinations were the Netherlands (163,700 MT), Japan (159,000 MT), Germany (126,800 MT), Mexico (68,200 MT), Taiwan (65,400 MT), and South Korea (59,000 MT).
